title: Kestrel and the Alibi
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: August Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
